_doc: Side quests handed out by people on the street (not enemies). Walk up, UP / LIGHT to talk. goal.type: kill (n, optional title), smash (n crates), fetch (an item dropped ahead at item_dx). Return to the giver to get paid. 'any' is the pool every other stage draws two from.

lines: My Biscuit ran off after the bins. Little dog, big opinions.
There's a tag on the collar with my number. And my debts.

goal.label: Find Biscuit's collar down the street

dock_street.done: That's his collar! He'll find his way back. He always does. He owes me money.

lines: Union says I can't break the crates. Union didn't say YOU can't.
Smash three for me. I'll call it stress relief on the form.
dock_street.done: Beautiful. I'm putting you down as 'weather'.

lines: The Repo boys took my mattress. With me ON it.
Knock out two of them and I'll sleep on the floor happy.
dock_street.done: Ha! Floor's cold but my heart is warm. Here, my emergency coins.

lines: Somebody clamped my boss's car. My boss is the car.
There's a ticket book blowing around the lot. Get it before the wind files it.
intake_lot.done: You saved a career. Mine. Unfortunately.

lines: The Coping Imps got out of group again.
Calm four of them down. Firmly. With your hands.
intake_lot.done: Group's back on schedule. I'm writing you in as 'progress'.

lines: My late husband's ring. The agents 'appraised' it right off my finger.
They dropped it running from a cop. It's down the strip, shining like guilt.
neon_exchange.done: Forty years. He'd say I should have sold it. I'd say shut up, Arturo.

lines: I hang the neon. The agents hang cameras in it. Every smile gets billed.
Break three of their smile cams. Red light, little lens. I'll file it as 'weather'.

goal.label: Smash 3 smile cams (or crates) for Pell

neon_exchange.done: Dark spots in the neon. Best thing that's happened to this street.

lines: Vest Ollie took my cab. Took the fares. Took the little tree air freshener.
Knock the vest off him and I drive you anywhere. Once. Downhill.
neon_exchange.done: The tree! He kept the tree! You're a good family. Weird, but good.

lines: Forty years riding these rails. The trains never stop for thugs.
Get two of 'em to meet the freight. Bell rings, you shove. Simple.

goal.label: Shove 2 thugs in front of a train

rail_bridge.done: Beautiful timing. You'd make a fine brakeman. Terrible person, fine brakeman.

lines: The Toll Bot charged me twice. Then charged me for asking.
Scrap one of them. I want my receipt back.
rail_bridge.done: Refund processed. In bolts. I'll take it.

lines: My shift pass blew down the bridge. No pass, no pay, no lunch.
It's a yellow ticket. Probably stuck on a sleeper by now.
rail_bridge.done: Lunch is saved. Here, have the half I wasn't going to eat.

lines: Thirty years I filed things. Now they file me under 'retired'.
Those clerks upstairs throw cabinets. Get a guard under one. File him properly.

goal.label: Get a guard FILED by a falling cabinet

city_hall.done: Alphabetical. Under G for gone. I could cry.

lines: Raven's office sent my eviction twice. The second one blew out the window.
Find it before it gets stamped. A letter in the gutter is a letter that never arrived.
city_hall.done: Never arrived! Legally! I'm keeping the apartment and the envelope.

lines: The Hall Guards track mud on my marble. Every night. On purpose.
Put two of them down. I'll mop around them.
city_hall.done: Clean floors and quiet halls. You two are welcome back. Wipe your feet.

lines: My goat Dolores ate the retreat brochure and ran into the field.
She left her bell behind. Find it and she'll come back. She always follows the bell.
copay_orchard.done: Dolores! She'll be back by supper. She owes me a brochure.

lines: Those Hay Pins keep stabbing my scarecrows. Professional jealousy.
Pull three of them out of the ground for me.
copay_orchard.done: My scarecrows can rest easy. Well. Stand easy. They don't really rest.

lines: The wellness people stacked their junk in my barn. Yoga crates. Gong crates.
Break three things. I'll call it composting.
copay_orchard.done: Room for the cows again. They're thrilled. You can tell by the silence.

lines: The Neon Scooters stole my mobility scooter. They painted flames on it.
Knock two of them off. I want it back with the flames. They're growing on me.
raven_grid.done: Flames and all! I'm going to be the fastest nana on the grid.

lines: A courier dropped a lemon-clinic package on the grid. It's ticking. Emotionally.
Bring it back before the clinic invoices the street for it.
raven_grid.done: Delivered to nobody. My favourite kind of delivery.

lines: Business is slow. Cars aren't breaking down enough.
Break three things on the grid. I'll tow the guilt.
raven_grid.done: Now THAT's a busy night. Here's a finder's fee.

lines: The cranes run themselves now. Badly. They drop crates on anything.
Get one of those ushers under a crate. Call it quality control.

goal.label: Get a thug CRATED by a crane

invoice_pier.done: Crated and shipped. Return address: nowhere.

lines: The Pier Gulls took my catch. Then my hat. Then my dignity.
Ground two of them. I'll take the hat back myself.
invoice_pier.done: My hat! A bit pecked. Like me.

lines: The original invoice copy blew out of the annex. With it, we prove they billed you twice.
It's a cream-coloured letter with a red seal. Find it.
invoice_pier.done: Proof. Stamped, sealed, and very petty. I love it.

lines: The Invoice Clerks broke the strike. Scabs with staplers.
Show three of them what a picket line feels like.
processing_floor.done: Solidarity. Here, from the strike fund. Don't tell the strike.

lines: They processed my family. All I have left is a photo, and I dropped it on the floor.
Please. It's in a little brown wallet.
processing_floor.done: That's us. Before the plan. Go finish it. For all of us.

lines: Thirty years shredding other people's futures. I'd like to shred something that deserves it.
Break three of their machines. I'll hold the bag.
processing_floor.done: Confetti. Finally, a celebration in this building.

lines: The thugs out here are LOUD. I have work at six.
Make five of them quiet. Permanently-ish.
any.done: Silence. Finally. I'll be up all night enjoying it.

lines: I need some 'storm damage' for a claim.
Break four things. I'll cut you in. Legally adjacent.
any.done: Act of God, signed and stamped. You're a natural disaster.

lines: Someone grabbed my wallet and dropped it running!
It's somewhere ahead. It has my whole personality in it.
any.done: My cards! My photos! My one good receipt! Take a reward, you saint.

lines: Those animals ate at my place and didn't pay.
Teach three of them what a bill feels like.
any.done: Paid in full. In bruises. Come eat, it's on the house.
